concerns.text: FR-001 requires validation that the downloaded Omni-Doc-1 dataset contains the required 'text-only' and 'image-only' label keys, but no task explicitly performs this validation after T006.
FR-002 mandates loading the Qwen-Image-VAE-2.0 model on CPU; the task list only implements a tiny‑vae wrapper (T008) and never attempts to load the specified Qwen model, creating a scope deviation.
Principle V (Versioning Discipline) requires that every artifact’s content hash be recorded in the project state YAML, yet there is no task that computes or writes these hashes.
The integration test (T021) checks pipeline success but does not verify that the state file’s `artifact_hashes` map is updated, leaving the version‑hashing requirement unimplemented.
